title: MD5 selected by name (erlang) — review required
description: Security code in erlang selects MD5 by algorithm name: crypto:hash(md5, Data). MD5 collisions are practical, so the selection is unsafe for passwords, signatures, or integrity of untrusted data. This lexical rule flags the selection; the reviewer confirms the use is a non-security checksum or upgrades it.
remediation: Select crypto:hash(sha256, ...) instead of MD5 for any security purpose. Keep MD5 only for non-security checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the MD5 name regardless of purpose. Call-shaped MD5 uses are separate rules.
